key_insight: Muon can substantially improve agentic RL post-training performance, but only under specific optimizer, estimator, and learning-rate settings.
engineering_relevance: For RL system design, the policy optimizer should be tuned jointly with the advantage estimator and learning rate rather than assumed interchangeable with AdamW.
method: Compared vanilla Muon vs. AdamW on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct under matched single-seed settings.
Applied Muon only to hidden weight matrices in Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO) and compared with GRPO and GraphGPO.
Varied learning rate to test when Muon helps or saturates performance across training windows.
evidence_signal: In single-seed ALFWorld evaluations, Muon raised GiGPO final-window validation success from 0.290 to 0.546 and improved GraphGPO at 1e-5 to 0.901 with higher normalized validation AUC (0.399 to 0.556).
watch_item: The findings are exploratory: results are single-seed and on one task/model setup, so multi-seed and cross-task validation are still needed.
paper_title: When Does Muon Help Agentic Reinforcement Learning?
